about: Image sources for tools/image_system.py. 'official': institutions whose own photos may be used under the licence they state (the licence must be written on the photo's page; without it the photo is LICENSE UNCLEAR and is not published automatically). 'agencies': news organisations whose photos are all rights reserved: never downloaded, only linked. Edit in /admin/ -> Full editor if a source changes its terms.
